summary: A 54-year-old woman was thrown from a horse on Forest Service Trail 441 in the West Elk Wilderness west of Ohio Pass, dislocating her hip; officers, Western Mountain Rescue and EMS responded and she was airlifted to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction.
location: Forest Service Trail 441, West Elk Wilderness, west of Ohio Pass
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Western Mountain Rescue; EMS
notes: Per-incident one-liner from the Gunnison County Sheriff's Office weekly press release (September 4, 2018 edition). Mined run 463.
